entity.name: Alejandro Castaneda
entity.description: Independent systems engineer and open source developer. Creator and sole maintainer of fedit, a CLI tool and MCP server for surgical file editing in AI pipelines.

projects.name: fedit
projects.description: A zero-dependency CLI tool and MCP server written in Go for surgical, precise file editing from the command line. Supports block-aware editing for Go, Python, Terraform/HCL, Nix and more. Used by AI agents via Model Context Protocol for controlled, token-efficient file manipulation in automated pipelines.

plans.name: Ongoing Maintenance
plans.description: Sustain active development, security improvements, documentation, and community support for fedit.
